predecessors.name: Electorate of Saxony
predecessors.text: the Electorate of Saxony, raised to a kingdom on 20 December 1806

successors.name: German Empire
successors.text: the kingdom as a state of the German Empire from 1871

ledger.x: 1815: Saxony loses about 60% of its land.
1815: page silent on the day the Prussian administration ended.
1866: page silent on the date the Prussian troops left.
1871: Saxony becomes a state of the German Empire.

wars.name: War of the Sixth Coalition (Saxony 1813)
wars.outcome: Saxony, Napoleon's ally, is occupied by Prussia from 1813 and loses about 60% of its land to Prussia at the Congress of Vienna (Final Act, 9 June 1815).

wars.name: Austro-Prussian War
wars.outcome: Prussia invades Saxony on 15 June 1866 but, with Austrian and French insistence, spares it from annexation; Saxony joins the North German Confederation.

certainty.note: Napoleonic boundaries with exclaves; no opened page gives the Saxon frontier; the 1813-1815 occupation is not a border.
The 1815 Congress of Vienna boundary with Prussia, unchanged to 1871; the Thuringian exclaves and the Lusatian line are below the 253 km2 grid cell.
